group_definitions.intents_participant: median share of actions sent to intents.near above 20%
group_definitions.high_frequency_regular: median of at least 200 transactions per month with regular inter-arrival gaps (gap CV below 0.6)
group_definitions.miniapp_pattern: at least half of the accounts carry a .tg or .sweat name and the median account touches fewer than two contracts
group_definitions.heavy_unclassified: median of at least 200 transactions per month without a regular gap pattern
group_definitions.multi_app: median account touches at least two contracts or two methods
group_definitions.light_general: none of the above: few actions, no mini-app name pattern
group_definitions.noise: HDBSCAN outliers, not assigned to any group

criteria.including_ambiguous: all groups except high_frequency_regular and miniapp_pattern (noise and heavy_unclassified count)

scope.observed_unit: accounts signing at least one transaction inside the sampled windows
scope.population_extrapolation: the QAA count multiplies the sampled share by NearBlocks mean daily active accounts; inclusion probability rises with activity, so the count is an illustrative rescaling and the share is the measured quantity
scope.identity: no verified human or bot labels exist; groups are behavioral patterns

validation: silhouette is geometric separation; group names describe behavior, not verified identity; see qaa_sensitivity.json
